_comment: TODO: real client data — sample copy for a trading company (it does not farm).

seo.title: {{brand}} · Selected Peruvian fruit for importers
seo.description: Peruvian trading company supplying blueberries, avocados, grapes, mangoes, mandarins and ginger to international importers and distributors.

common.whatsappMessage: Hello, I'd like a quote for Peruvian fruit from Vibrance.

hero.title: Peruvian fruit, selected for the world
hero.subtitle: We choose the growers, control quality and manage the export of blueberries, avocados, grapes, mangoes, mandarins and ginger.

origen.heading: Born in a blooming desert
lines: Between the Pacific Ocean and the Andes, Peru has valleys where sun and mountain water give fruit flavour, colour and good post-harvest life.
We don't farm: we select. We work with growers on the coast and in the central jungle who meet our standards, so an importer has a single partner for several fruits and regions of Peru.
origen.imageAlt: Green farmland in the middle of the Peruvian coastal desert
origen.mapText: We source from growers in these regions, each with the right climate for its crop.
origen.mapLabel: Map of Peru showing where the products are sourced
origen.treeLabel: Illustrated tree growing blueberries, avocados, grapes, mangoes, mandarins and ginger, which fall into a Vibrance basket.
origen.closeTitle: From these regions to your table
origen.closeText: Tell us which fruit you need and we'll confirm availability and whether it can enter your country.

proceso.heading: From the grower to your warehouse
proceso.intro: Five steps we control so every shipment arrives complete, on time and with its paperwork in order.

productores.title: Grower selection
productores.text: We choose growers for quality, traceability and compliance with each market's requirements.

calidad.title: Quality control
calidad.text: We check size, Brix (sweetness), ripeness and condition of every lot before approving it for export.
calidad.alt: Fruit being checked in quality control

empaque.title: Packing
empaque.text: We coordinate packing in certified packhouses, in the format and labelling each customer needs.

frio.title: Cold chain
frio.text: Fruit is pre-cooled and travels temperature-controlled to the port or airport.

envio.title: Documents and shipping
envio.text: We handle phytosanitary and origin certificates and customs paperwork, and ship by sea or air.
envio.alt: Fruit crates being loaded onto the dispatch truck

productos.heading: What we offer
productos.intro: Fresh Peruvian produce, graded by size and packed to suit each market.

palta.name: Hass avocado
palta.summary: Creamy, with pebbly skin that darkens as it ripens.
palta.presentations: Fresh fruit, bulk or mesh bags

uva.name: Table grapes
uva.varieties: Red Globe, Sweet Globe, Autumn Crisp

mango.name: Mango
mango.summary: Fibreless flesh, rich aroma and bright colour.

mandarina.name: Mandarin
mandarina.summary: Easy to peel, juicy and deeply coloured.

kion.name: Ginger
kion.summary: Aromatic, spicy rhizome, washed and graded.

productos.marketsNote: For other destinations, ask us: we check the protocol before quoting.
productos.quoteNote: Varieties, sizes and presentations are tailored in each quote.

datos.heading: Our offer at a glance
datos.intro: One trading partner to source several Peruvian products all year round.

mercados.label: markets with an active phytosanitary protocol for Peruvian fruit

datos.mapText: Markets with an active phytosanitary protocol for at least one of our products. Hover over each point to see how many.
datos.mapLabel: World map showing the markets our products can be exported to
datos.accessText: Not every product can enter every country. This table shows where an active protocol exists; for anything else we confirm the situation before quoting.
datos.accessCaption: Markets with an active phytosanitary protocol for each product
datos.certText: We work with certified packing houses (BRCGS, HACCP, GMP), authorized by SENASA and registered with the FDA. The packing house and certifications for each shipment are confirmed in the quote.

nosotros.heading: Every shipment, legally backed and insured
nosotros.bio: I am a lawyer and insurance broker with more than 15 years in risk management. I bring that standard to every export: clear contracts, cargo insurance, and experience with letters of credit and credit insurance, so you and the grower can work with peace of mind.

pillars.contracts: Clear contracts between grower, trader and importer
pillars.credit: Experience with letters of credit and credit insurance

nosotros.quote: Vibrance is a company that vibrates with love.

story.p1: Vibrance Inca Harvest S.A.C. was born with great affection and hope. Its mission is to bring order to exports and to support other exporters.
story.p2: It also aims to help farmers and landowners receive a fairer price for the products the land gives us.
story.p3: It was born with a vibration of love, to bring about positive change in the hearts of Peruvians, who are so generous with the world, while being a profitable company with a positive human and business impact.

como.heading: How we work
como.intro: The basic terms for quoting and shipping, clear from the start.

incoterms.a: We work with FOB, CFR and CIF.

volume.a: One 40' reefer container per order. For air freight, depending on the product.

payment.a: Letter of credit, or 80% advance and 20% balance; other terms on request.

inco.hint: Pick an Incoterm to see which leg Vibrance covers.

fob.name: Free On Board
fob.desc: We deliver the cargo on board the vessel at Callao. From there, freight and insurance are on you.

cfr.name: Cost and Freight
cfr.desc: We also pay ocean freight to your destination port. Risk passes to you once the cargo is on board.

cif.name: Cost, Insurance and Freight
cif.desc: We pay ocean freight and marine insurance to your destination port. Risk passes to you once the cargo is on board.

contacto.slogan: The best of Peru, in every box.
contacto.text: Tell us which fruit you need, the volume and the destination. We'll send you a proposal.

form.title: Request a quote

footer.tagline: Peruvian fresh fruit trading company for importers and distributors worldwide.
